description: List the use cases VibeCodePicks tracks (e.g. landing-page, mobile-app, code-review, ai-game-development) with how often each was discussed and the top 3 tools people mention for it, from a dated window of public community posts. Use to find a scenario slug, or when the user asks 'what do people use for X'. No input. Returns slug, title, mention count, top tool ids, page URL, and the date window.
name: list_scenarios
